population.law: uniform over all (p,a) with p in [17,31,47,61,97], 1<=a<p; Query(a,(p-1)//2,p,1)
population.known_structure: The public Euler-style balanced family admits analytic structure and exhaustive enumeration; both are allowed to the ordinary comparator. No hardness or prediction advantage claim.
population.state: cold Adapter(cache_cap=0) on each request; profiles retained separately; warm histories outside this sampling theorem

profile.sampling: Seeded uniform-with-replacement development trace; statistical theorem assumes IID. Independent exhaustive population audit will check the realized coordinate-coverage event directly.
profile.radius: integer-checkable dyadic rational, union across declared fixed checkpoints and nonconstant feature cells

selection: Finite complete-policy max lower saving versus fallback; conditional-continuation selection and all-in/setup-coverage flags kept distinct. Cheap gross-value pre-screen may skip assessment, but its own cost is recorded.

self_audit.sample_unit: whole fixed controller batch, with new state per episode; baseline and charged exact comparator use same query batch

comparators: immediate fixed policies with same shortcut and cold state
ordinary controller using identical profile, catalogue and rule
paid exhaustive population profiling; no sampling uncertainty
checks: independent exact population means and certificate containment
exact rational versus separate scalar calculations
no future labels in profile selection interface
assessment overhead and setup cost on fallback branch
finite-prefix simultaneous coverage versus optional-stopping witness
full own-program identity frozen before audit
failure_policy: Preserve failing run sources, manifests and outputs; version changed code and run a new documented development attempt. No quiet replacement or final evaluation freeze.
